commentaire: Enchainement sur l'absence ecrite #f : quatre idiomes Racket qui doivent rendre le meme terme. Sans equivalent dans cas_ml.json, OCaml n'ayant qu'une ecriture naturelle (match ... with None | Some).

equivalentes.etiquette: let puis if sur la valeur
equivalentes.code:
(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (let ([x (premier l)])
    (if x (* 2 x) #f)))

(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (let ([x (premier l)])
    (if (not x) #f (* 2 x))))

(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (let ([x (premier l)])
    (and x (* 2 x))))

(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (let ([x (premier l)])
    (cond [(not x) #f]
          [else (* 2 x)])))

(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (match (premier l)
    [#f #f]
    [x (* 2 x)]))

(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (let ([n (premier l)])
    (if n (* n 2) #f)))

distinctes.code:
(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (let ([x (premier l)])
    (if x (+ 2 x) #f)))

(define (premier l) (if (null? l) #f (first l)))
(define (double-tete l)
  (let ([x (premier l)])
    (if x (* 2 x) 0)))
